pages.text: The $(d)Ender Dragon Health$() Gene allows players to $(9)completely negate damage$() while a $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/dragon_health_crystal)Dragon Health Crystal$(/l) is in their inventory.$(br2)Any damage they would take is instead dealt to the Crystal's durability.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)3/11 - Ender Dragon
